name: CES 151 拖把断了 鸟击一发失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 151, you are at gate 232, you have got information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 151，在 232 号登机口，已收到通播 S，向武汉放行请求飞往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 151, gate 232, information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 151，232 号登机口，通播 S，请求飞往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, Wuhan Delivery, information S is valid, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, Runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, ZF-01 departure, cruising level 10100 meters, after departure, contact 123.4, squawk 4125.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，武汉放行，通播 S 有效，许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，起始爬升至 1800 米，ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 10100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125。
cards.referenceText: Information S is valid, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, Runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, ZF-01 departure, cruising level 10100 meters, after departure, contact 123.4, squawk 4125, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播 S 有效，许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，起始爬升至 1800 米，ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 10100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125，CES 151。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 151, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 151，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, push back and start up approved, push back to taxiway Z4, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Z4，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, push back to taxiway Z4, facing west, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Z4，机头朝西，CES 151。

cards.audioText: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar was broke and slash bent, report it to Ground controller and request a new tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: B：推出过程中，拖杆断裂并弯曲，向地面管制员报告并请求新的拖杆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 151, the tow bar was bent during push back, request a new tow bar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 151，推出过程中拖杆弯曲，请求新的拖杆。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back with engines running on taxiway Z4, ask Ground for taxiing instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在滑行道 Z4 已完成推出，发动机运转，向地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 151, push back and start up completed, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 151，推出和开车完成，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CES 151。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, hold short of A7, give way to Airbus 320 coming from your right, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，A7 外等待，避让从你右侧来的 Airbus 320，交通脱离后继续经滑行道 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of A7, traffic in sight, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A to holding point Runway 36R, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: A7 外等待，看到飞机，交通脱离后继续经滑行道 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CES 151。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, report it to Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，向武汉塔台报告并核实风。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 151, holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 151，跑道 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，请求风检查。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 151, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: The tail wind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to Runway 18L and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 151，风 200 度，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台改用跑道 18L 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 151, the tail wind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 151，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne from Runway 18L, you encountered a bird strike during the initial climb, 1 of your engines failed, inform the situation to Wuhan Approach and tell the controller you intend to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你从跑道 18L 离地，初始爬升中遭遇鸟击，1 台发动机失效，向武汉进近通报情况并告诉管制员你打算返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CES 151, we encountered a bird strike during initial climb, 1 of our engines failed, request return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CES 151，我们在初始爬升中遭遇鸟击，1 台发动机失效，请求返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 跑道 36R，CES 151。

cards.audioText: B: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: B：由于强顺风，你想改用跑道 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 151, request change to Runway 18L due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 151，因强顺风，请求改用跑道 18L。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right, direct to WHA, contact Wuhan Approach 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，同意改用跑道 18L，保持 600 米，右转，直飞 WHA，联系武汉进近121.7。
cards.referenceText: Change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right, direct to WHA, 121.7, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意改用跑道 18L，保持 600 米，右转，直飞 WHA，121.7，CES 151。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，爬升并保持 900 米，过 WHA 后，飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 18L。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 900 米，过 WHA 后，飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 18L，CES 151。
